name: The other end of a point-to-point link from a site on a frequency
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN v.site_id_a = {site_id} THEN v.site_id_b ELSE v.site_id_a END AS far_site_id, CASE WHEN v.site_id_a = {site_id} THEN v.label_b ELSE v.label_a END AS far_name, CASE WHEN v.site_id_a = {site_id} THEN v.lat_b ELSE v.lat_a END AS far_lat, CASE WHEN v.site_id_a = {site_id} THEN v.lon_b ELSE v.lon_a END AS far_lon FROM v_links v WHERE (v.site_id_a = {site_id} OR v.site_id_b = {site_id}) AND v.frequency_hz = {center_hz} ORDER BY v.id
